g.text: Constraints: friend_requests enforces CHECK (sender_id <> recipient_id) and a partial UNIQUE index
on unordered pair (LEAST, GREATEST) WHERE status = 'PENDING' (SRS FR-FRD-03).
friendships and conversations enforce CHECK (player_low_id < player_high_id) and UNIQUE (player_low_id, player_high_id).
Live match state (hands, boneyard, board chain, turn order) lives in authoritative server memory;
PostgreSQL stores rooms, seats and final outcomes (WIN, LOSS, DRAW per participant).
